ALLOCATES.label: allocates
ALLOCATES.purpose: Connects a concrete JCL DD allocation to the dataset it resolves at runtime.

ASSIGNED_TO.label: assigned to
ASSIGNED_TO.purpose: Connects a COBOL SELECT file handle to the external DD name used by JCL.

BINDS.label: binds
BINDS.purpose: Connects a JCL allocation statement to the DD name exposed to a program step.

CALLS.label: calls
CALLS.purpose: Represents an observed COBOL control-flow transfer from a caller to a program or paragraph.

CONTAINS.label: contains
CONTAINS.purpose: Expresses a deterministic structural parent-child relationship in source or job definitions.

DECLARES.label: declares
DECLARES.purpose: Records that a source artifact or program defines the connected entity.

DEPENDS_ON.label: depends on
DEPENDS_ON.purpose: Represents a modern source-level dependency between Java types.

DERIVED_FROM.label: derived from
DERIVED_FROM.purpose: States that a curated business rule is supported by specific legacy source evidence.

EXECUTES.label: executes
EXECUTES.purpose: Connects a JCL step to the program or utility named on its EXEC statement.

HAS_DD.label: has DD
HAS_DD.purpose: Associates a JCL step with one of its DD allocation statements.

HAS_RULE.label: has rule
HAS_RULE.purpose: Associates a modernization workload with a curated behavior claim in its semantic scope.

HAS_SCENARIO.label: has scenario
HAS_SCENARIO.purpose: Associates a workload with a public or verifier-private behavior scenario.

IMPLEMENTED_BY.label: implemented by
IMPLEMENTED_BY.purpose: Maps a curated business rule to the modern Java method intended to implement it.

LEGACY_ENTRYPOINT.label: legacy entry point
LEGACY_ENTRYPOINT.purpose: Identifies the authoritative legacy program at the boundary of a modernization workload.

MODERN_ENTRYPOINT.label: modern entry point
MODERN_ENTRYPOINT.purpose: Identifies a modern application or batch configuration type that starts the replacement workload.

READS.label: reads
READS.purpose: Records that a COBOL paragraph consumes records through the connected file handle.

READS_WRITES.label: reads and writes
READS_WRITES.purpose: Records that a COBOL paragraph uses the connected file handle for both input and update operations.

SCHEDULED_BY.label: scheduled by
SCHEDULED_BY.purpose: Maps a modernization workload to the legacy JCL job that schedules its execution.

USES_COPYBOOK.label: uses copybook
USES_COPYBOOK.purpose: Records that a COBOL program imports and depends on the connected copybook.

VERIFIED_BY.label: verified by
VERIFIED_BY.purpose: Connects a business-rule claim to the test or scenario that supplies independent behavioral evidence.

WRITES.label: writes
WRITES.purpose: Records that a COBOL paragraph creates or updates records through the connected file handle.
